name: Recall Harbor
intro: A private place to keep useful ideas, notes, and conversations within reach.
imageAlt: A quiet harbor protected by an illuminated stone breakwater
overview: Recall Harbor grew out of a problem I kept running into: valuable context was scattered across notes, chats, and half-remembered ideas.
The product brings that material into one calm, searchable home. Imports, tags, and an optional ChatGPT connection make it easier to recover the right thought when it becomes useful again.
challenge: Make personal knowledge easy to capture without turning it into another system that needs constant maintenance.
approach: Start with the moments where memory breaks down, then use agentic workflows to reduce the work between saving something and finding it again.

highlights.title: Bring it together
highlights.text: Import useful material from the places where it already lives.

highlights.title: Find the thread
highlights.text: Search and tags make old context available when a new problem brings it back into focus.

highlights.title: Keep it private
highlights.text: Designed as a personal knowledge space rather than a public feed.

next: Continue refining the capture and retrieval loop around real daily use.
